# LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations with Ollama — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations with Ollama. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-14 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Definitions

- [statement] LangChain's Python Ollama chat integration is the langchain-ollama package; ChatOllama supports bind_tools tool calling, image input, token streaming, native async and logprobs, and the docs example uses validate_model_on_init=True. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/integrations/chat/ollama.md · keywords: LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations with Ollama · also: https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-ollama/langchain_ollama/chat_models/ChatOllama

## How it works

- [statement] In LlamaIndex's Ollama LLM, structured_predict sets the response format to the Pydantic class's JSON schema (overriding json_mode); tool calls are limited to one per response unless allow_parallel_tool_calls is set; tool IDs equal the tool name because Ollama supplies none; additional_kwargs merge after defaults and override temperature/num_ctx. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://developers.llamaindex.ai/python/framework-api-reference/llms/ollama/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Third-party guides report Ollama truncates over-long prompts silently, dropping early turns or the prompt prefix, which can remove retrieved RAG chunks or system instructions without any error. (low confidence) — https://fast.io/resources/ollama-context-window/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] ChatOllama has a reasoning parameter: True returns reasoning separately in additional_kwargs reasoning_content, False disables it, None (default) leaves model behavior so think tags may appear in the main content. It can be set per call. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-ollama/langchain_ollama/chat_models/ChatOllama · keywords: LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations with Ollama · also: https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/integrations/chat/ollama.md
- [statement] LlamaIndex's Ollama LLM class (llama-index-llms-ollama) defaults base_url to http://localhost:11434, takes context_window=-1 (read from model info via the client, else a DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW constant), and has a thinking option (bool or low/medium/high) and a json_mode flag. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://developers.llamaindex.ai/python/framework-api-reference/llms/ollama/ · keywords: LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations with Ollama · also: https://developers.llamaindex.ai/python/framework/integrations/embeddings/ollama_embedding/
- [statement] LlamaIndex embeds via a separate package, llama-index-embeddings-ollama (OllamaEmbedding, subclass of BaseEmbedding); LangChain uses OllamaEmbeddings inside langchain-ollama. The LlamaIndex docs example uses embeddinggemma (768-dim vectors). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://developers.llamaindex.ai/python/framework/integrations/embeddings/ollama_embedding/ · keywords: LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations with Ollama · also: https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain-ollama/langchain_ollama/chat_models/ChatOllama
- [statement] Context-length trap: Ollama's server default context depends on VRAM (under 24 GiB: 4k; 24-48 GiB: 32k; 48 GiB or more: 256k) and its docs recommend at least 64000 tokens for agents, web search and coding tools. Set num_ctx in ChatOllama or context_window/additional_kwargs in LlamaIndex, or OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH on the server, and check with ollama ps. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.ollama.com/context-length · keywords: LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations with Ollama · also: https://fast.io/resources/ollama-context-window/
